FQCARDDESCRIPTION.Fireball:
Deals {0_damage} damage.
1d2 chance to burn the target, dealing 3 damage over 3 turns.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.Tornado:
Deals {0_damage} damage.
1d2 chance to apply an air effect that reduces movement by 2 for 2 turns.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.Frostfire:
Requires 1 burn or freeze effect.
Deals {0_damage} damage.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.FrostStrike:
Deals {0_damage} damage.
1d2 chance to freeze the target, increasing the cost of their spells by 1 action point for 3 turns.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.EarthFracture:
Deals {0_damage} damage (Xmax = {0_xmax}).
1d(4-X) chance to apply an earth effect that reduces the target's dodge by 1 for 4 turns.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.VoidAssassin: Requires 2 different elemental effects. +1 to critical chance for this attack for each effect applied to the target. Deals {0_damage} damage (Xmax = {0_xmax}, Ymax = {0_ymax}).
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.ManaCapture: When you take damage, recover {0_mana} mana points.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.Incantation:
Defer X action points to the next turn.
Xmax = {0_xmax}
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.MagicPlastron:
Requires 1 active earth or ice effect on the target.
Remove the effect, and you gains 10 + 3*@cha temporary hit points for 2 turns.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.IceWave:
Requires 1 active air or ice effect on at least one target.
Deals {0_damage} damage to all adjacent targets.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.Fog:
Requires 1 active air or earth effect on at least one target.
All enemy targets lose @int in critical chance and @wis in dodge for 3 turns.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.FireShock:
Requires 1 active air or fire effect on one of the two targets.
Deals {0_damage} damage to up to 2 enemies.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.Meteor:
Requires 1 active earth or fire effect on one of the targets.
Place a 3x3-tile area.
Deals {0_damage} damage to covered targets.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.DamagePropagation: Each time you play a card that affects a single target, choose another target within range. It takes @wis damage per turn for 3 turns.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.Charge:
Charge an enemy within 9 squares.
For 1 turn, increase damage by @dex + 1d4 and critical chance by @str.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.HeroicStrike:
Deal {0_damage} damage.
You may choose not to spend your mana point and instead lose (6 - @con) hit points.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.ManaSurge:
Regain twice the amount of mana points spent on your last spell.
(Costs 1 less action point per @wis)
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.ShieldBash: If you take damage from a target within 6 squares, you leap to an adjacent square next to it (the closest to you) and deal @cha+1d3 damage to it.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.Hemorrhage: Deal {0_damage} damage and make the target bleed, dealing an additional @str damage per turn for 2 turns.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.RageSurge: Sacrifice 3 + @con hit points and regain 1 mana point; your damage is increased by @con for 1 turn.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.BladeCharging:
You charge your attack by X, and the charge is retained after your turn.
When you reach 12 charge points, your next attack deals double damage and you discard this card.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.Sharpening:
Increase critical chance by 2X until the end of your next turn.
(X max = @cha)
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.ArmorReinforcement:
Recover 1 hit point at the start of each turn
(lasts @con turns)
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.BladeWhirlwind:
You charge your attack by X, and the charge is retained after your turn. The spell costs 8 points.
Deal {0_damage} damage to all adjacent targets.
You may spend 5 hit points instead if you have no mana.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.TauntingStrike:
Deal {0_damage} damage, and the target can only choose you as its target on its next turn.
You may spend 4 hit points instead if you have no mana.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.UltimateRage:
Increase damage dealt by 2X and sacrifice X hit point(s) by turn
(X max = @con)
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.EnchantedWhip:
Deals {0_damage} damage.
Range is increased by 1.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.MirrorImages: Increases evasion by @dex until you are hit (not stackable).
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.Shuriken: Deals {0_damage} damage and 1d3 chance to cause the target to bleed (dealing 3*@cha damage over 3 turns).
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.PoisonedShuriken: Deals {0_damage} damage and 1d4 chance to poison the target (dealing 4*@cha damage over 4 turns).
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.SungInspiration:
Increases the critical score of allies within range by 1 (replayable {0_replayable} times).
Draw a card.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.FeveredDance:
Increases the evasion score of allies within range by 1 (replayable {0_replayable} times).
Draw a card.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.DaggerCloud: Place a dagger cloud on a target. It deals X + 1d8 damage each turn for @cha turns, where X is your range bonus.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.ShurikenVolley:
Place a 2-tile cone.
Deals {0_damage} damage to covered targets, where X is your range bonus.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.ApothecaryI:
Choose one:
- Life Potion: 1d4 + @wis health
- Reach Potion: +1 range for 3 turns
- Speed Potion: 1 + @wis movement for 3 turns
- Earth Strength Potion: Reduces the target's evasion by @wis for 3 turns
- Wind Potion: Reduces the target's movement by @wis for 3 turns
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.EtherealPlanePassage: Swap places with the target, dealing or healing the distance between the targets + @wis (non-critical).
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.IllusoryStrike: Deals {0_damage} damage, where X is your range bonus.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.ManaDrain: Gain X mana points, where X is the number of targets within range. Costs @wis action points less.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.CommunicatingVessels: Transforms 1 mana into 4 action points or vice versa (You can cast this spell @wis more times this turn, usable only on your turn, at least once).
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.ApothecaryII:
Choose one:
- Life Potion: 1d4 + @wis health
- Reach Potion: +1 range for 3 turns
- Speed Potion: 1 + @wis movement for 3 turns
- Fire Potion: Burns the target, dealing 1 damage per turn for @wis turns
- Frost Potion: Reduces the target's action points by @wis for 3 turns
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.BackflipStrike: Deals {0_damage} damage, and pushes the target back by @dex spaces to distance them from the target. Increases range by 1.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.Backstab: Increases all damage by X + 1d@dex for 1 turn, where X is your range bonus.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.BlackPlague:
Duplicate all beneficial and detrimental effects on a target.
Reusable @con times.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.SideAttack: Deals {0_damage} damage to targets on the left and right (or top and bottom).
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.CircleAttack: Deals {0_damage} damage to targets within range. X, being the range bonus, also reduces the minimum range.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.LightEnergy:
2 Charges.
Deals {0_damage} damage or restores {1_heal} health.
Grants 1 zeal point when you have used both charges of the spell.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.Curse:
Deals @wis damage per turn for 3 turns.
(Unavoidable, Non-critical)
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.MagicShield:
Prevents the next 2*@wis wounds on a target and increases healing by 2 while the shield is active.
(The number of wounds prevented can be stacked up to 2 times, up to 12 points.)
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.Exorcism:
Removes 1 beneficial or detrimental effect from a target.
This spell costs @cha action points less.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.InstantCurse:
The target that damaged you receives a curse: @cha damage per turn for 3 turns.
(Stackable up to 3 times, unavoidable, non-critical)
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.ArcaneExplosion:
Deals {0_damage} damage to a cursed target, or place a 1-tile-radius area dealing {1_damage} damage to covered targets, at least one of them cursed.
(Xmax = {0_xmax})
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.Epiphany:
Increases healing done by @con/3.
(Stackable up to 2 times)
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.EmergencyHealing:
Discard X cards.
Restore @int * X health points.
(Xmax = {0_xmax})
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.ManaInfusion:
Recover 1 mana point. The spell costs nothing after the first use.
Costs @wis fewer action points on the first turn.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.ManaShield:
Each time you take damage, you can recover @con health points for 1 mana point.
Reusable @wis times.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.DivineShield:
When a target takes damage, restores their lost health points
The target cannot lose health points until their next turn.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.LightStrike:
Deals {0_damage} damage to enemies and then restores 2*@int health points to you and your allies on a second use (no cost).
(Unavoidable, non-critical)
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.VengefulShield: When a previously chosen target takes damage from an enemy, you can deal @wis*@int damage to the attacker.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.EmpatheticShield: When a previously chosen target takes damage from an enemy, you can restore @wis*@int health points to the target.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.RightPunch:
Deals {0_damage} damage.
You may play this card again if you have already spent 4 action points this turn.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.LeftPunch:
Deals {0_damage} damage.
You may play this card again if you have already spent 5 action points this turn before playing it.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.InhibitingCape: Remove 1 detrimental effect from yourself and you lose (2 - @con) health points.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.SecretWeapons: Discard X cards, dealing (X + @cha) unavoidable and non-critical damage.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.QuickDodge: When you take damage, recover 2*@dex health points. (Can prevent falling to 0 health points)
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.Conversion:
Convert X zeal points into X mana points.
(Xmax = {0_xmax})
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.FlashMove: Move up to 7 + @dex spaces in one direction (without obstacles). All targets you pass through take 3 + @str + 1d6 damage.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.ZenMeditation:
You restore (3 + @con) * X health points.
Xmax = {0_xmax}
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.ZealousShield:
Additional cost:
-2 action points on the next turn.
When you receive any spell, gain (2 + @cha) zeal points.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.PhantomBlade: Deals {0_damage} damage with @str as additional critical score for this attack.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.Concealment:
You are untouchable and your movement is increased by 4 until the end of your next turn.
Damage on your next turn only will be increased by 1d(@dex).
You cannot deal damage this turn.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.KiBreath:
Draw X cards from your deck, and gain 2X action points for this turn.
(Xmax = {0_xmax})
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.Necromancy:
Pay the cost only once. The card can then be reused for free.
Increase the spell’s range by @cha.
Summon a level 1 skeleton at the chosen location.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.GreenShadowBolt:
Deal {0_damage} poison damage and 1d6 damage on the next turn.
Summon a level 1 skeleton on a square adjacent to the witch.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.GiantSkeleton:
Summon a level 4 skeleton.
3 + (3@cha) hit points
@cha + 1d6 melee damage
Movement: 4
Acts after the witch.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.SquareOfSkeletons:
Summon up to 4 level 1 skeletons on squares adjacent to the witch.
(Costs @cha fewer action points)
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.PowerInflux: Gain as many action points this turn as there are skeletons in play.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.ShadowExplosion:
Place a square area with sides of @int tiles.
Deals {0_damage} psychic damage to covered targets.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.ShadowChanneling:
No skeleton can be destroyed until your next turn.
Costs @cha fewer action point.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.ManaInflux:
Restore 2X mana where X is your sacrifice score.
Costs @wis fewer action point.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.AgilityInflux:
Gain evasion score equal to the number of skeletons in play for 2 turns.
Costs @wis fewer action point.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.BoneShield: Increase skeletons' hit points by (@cha/3) (lasts 2 turns).
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.LifeInflux: Restores 2*@wis + 3X life to a target, where X is your sacrifice score.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.ShadowForm: You lose 6-@cha hit points. Increases the witch's and skeletons' damage by @cha/3 for 1 round
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.PreciseShot:
Deals {0_damage} damage,
X = distance to the target.
 Xmin = {0_xmin}, Xmax = {0_xmax}. The range of this spell is raised by @dex
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.WeakPointStudy:
Usable only when a target dodges one of your cards: Recover the dodged card or two cards from your discard pile and add them to your hand.
Increases all damage by @int.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.PiercingShot:
